audience: Peruvian companies that file electronic invoices, receipts and notes with SUNAT through tefacturo

useCases.title: Check the SUNAT status of a document before resending it
useCases.text: Read the SUNAT answer, the declaration state and the mail delivery state of one document. Check the series before you file a new document.

useCases.title: Get the PDF or the XML of an issued document
useCases.text: Get the printed PDF or the signed XML of one issued document. Send the PDF to the customer, or store the XML for your records.

useCases.title: Keep the SUNAT receipt of each accepted document
useCases.text: Get the SUNAT receipt (CDR) of one document. The receipt is an XML answer from SUNAT that shows the document was accepted.

useCases.title: Preview an invoice layout before you file it
useCases.text: Render a PDF preview of a document from its JSON. The preview has no number and nothing goes to SUNAT.

useCases.title: File a new invoice or receipt with SUNAT
useCases.text: Check the series, preview the layout, then file a new invoice or a receipt with SUNAT. Filing cannot be undone.

useCases.title: Correct a filed document with a note or a voiding summary
useCases.text: Adjust an earlier invoice or receipt with a credit note or a debit note, or send a voiding summary. Each one needs a reason. Check the voiding summary later with the status tool.
